invariants: The explicit Python portable extension validates the complete ZIP entry set before writing extracted files.
Both a package at archive root and one wrapped package are written directly into the one transaction-owned staging root.
Installation and upgrade perform no redundant rename of an extracted wrapper directory before validation; publication still uses the existing profile transaction and journal.
Existing traversal, case collision, link, encrypted entry, count and size refusals remain active before extraction.
Actual Windows handles denying delete-sharing on the extracted directory are held until validation; add and upgrade then boot and execute the installed plugin successfully.
identity: The source manifest, package identity, exact released files and profile transaction root remain authoritative.
ownership: The installer owns one stage and cleans it on failure; validation runs before publication, and the existing journal owns recovery of publication.
ordering: Full archive preflight precedes extraction; root normalization precedes validation; transaction publication follows validation.
errors: Invalid containers fail without extracted files; genuine publication failures retain their existing transaction behavior. No retry, sleep or PermissionError suppression.
cancellation: This synchronous stopped-profile operation retains its exclusive ProfileLease; no new cancellation or live replacement promise.
adaptation: Upstream plugin management delegates to pnpm and has no Python ZIP installer. This is an existing explicitly supported Python portable extension regression fix, not an upstream source/native parity certification.
open_questions: Complete clean candidate and portable acceptance pending. Historical WinError 5 external holder remains unidentified; avoiding the redundant rename is verified with actual controlled Windows sharing handles. Arbitrary JS/npm installation, native wheels/ABI, public trust/licensing and Win7 remain separate.
